text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
W-What a race...!
Narita Brian's way too strong...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Waaah, Ogurin lost...

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
To think she took down Oguri too.
Nobody's gonna be able to stop this momentum...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
"She's already on the level of the 'Emperor.'
No, maybe even beyond that...!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: "...A total defeat. Thank you for a great race."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hah... What are you talking about?
The light hasn't left your eyes yet.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
However, a loss is still a loss.
And you will surely go far ahead of me.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...I heard the other day.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: So Symboli Rudolf is running in the upcoming Japan Cup too.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: She is strong. Stronger than me.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I must not let my guard down.
She is the "Emperor," the "Undefeated Triple Crown Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I know.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I am more painfully aware of her strength
than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...Even so, you're still
going to pursue strength, aren't you?"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...I should excuse myself soon as well.
I need to go say goodbye to everyone."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: That I haven't given up yet either.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Symboli Rudolf is running
in the upcoming Japan Cup, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was information that had only just
been broadcast on the news.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: So... Rudolf-san will be running as well!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I will also be running
in this Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Upon learning that Narita Brian would step onto the stage of the Autumn Senior Triple Crown starting with the Tenno Sho (Autumn)—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"I, too, have decided to enter
as one of those who will meet the challenge."

text_block_list.name: Press Corps
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOH!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
D-Does that mean you see
Brian-san as your rival?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...I believe the term 'rival' is ill-suited here.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I simply became curious, that is all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Between her and me as we are now, I want to see
who is stronger when we clash."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Murmur...!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Her and me, as we are right now, huh...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
She looks calm, but her fighting spirit is practically overflowing.
...That's the Student Council President for you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
However... she is stronger than anyone. Running
away with our tails between our legs is not an option.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I want to win.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian held that posture
for a while after that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next leg of the Fall Senior Triple Crown is the Japan Cup.
—Waiting there is none other than "the strongest."
